title: Commercial-to-GCC High Microsoft 365 & Azure Migration Program (Exchange, SharePoint, Teams, AVD)
author_notes: Includes a project to move from azure to GCC high. Migrate azure servers, apps and critically sharepoint, vdi, azure using Quest, Sharegate, and other common migration tools.

Scope: multi-workstream PROGRAM migrating a commercial Microsoft 365 + Azure estate to a GCC High sovereign tenant (cross-cloud, not in-place; eligibility/sponsorship + AOS-G gated). Workstreams: Identity (Entra), Exchange, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, Azure IaaS servers (Azure Migrate + ASR), Azure apps/PaaS, AVD/VDI. Tools: Quest On Demand, ShareGate, Azure Migrate/ASR, native.
pricing: T5 (enterprise program) — multi-workstream cross-cloud / sovereign-cloud program; anchor $5,995, the highest in the catalog, above the prior product per the monotonicity rule.
